items.title: Bitcoin Hits 12-Week Low as Fed Rate Fears Undo Most of Summer Rally
items.summary: Bitcoin is back near August levels as persistent inflation, growing expectations of another interest-rate hike and ETF withdrawals pressure prices.

items.title: JPMorgan reports 36% rise in Strategy share holdings and $540 million in BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF
items.summary: JPMorgan reported 224,545 more Strategy shares in the third quarter as its BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings climbed to 11.4 million shares.

items.title: Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT
items.summary: Jane Street ended Q3 with 19% fewer shares in BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF, and a higher share price lifted the stake’s value to $957 million.

items.title: Bitcoin slides below $70K amid thin liquidity, ETF outflows
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 as crypto sentiment hit its lowest level in more than four months, with analysts warning of institutional outflows, thinning liquidity and elevated leverage.
